update.title: Updates
update.subtitle: Choose a release track, check signed manifests, and update this native GPROXY installation.

preferences.title: Update preferences
preferences.description: These preferences are shared by every administrator of this instance.
preferences.channelHint: Build default follows the channel embedded in this binary. Alpha builds use dev(alpha); staging(beta) tracks continuously replaced builds; stable(release) follows stable releases.
preferences.automaticHint: Check when the Console opens and show a notice only when a newer build is available. Disabled by default.

check.title: Signed update
check.description: The manifest signature, archive digest, target, and data-version floor are verified before installation.
check.idle: No check has run on this page yet.
check.availableHint: Version {{version}} is ready to verify and install.
check.currentHint: This installation matches the newest build on the selected channel.

actions.applyError: The update was refused or could not be applied.
actions.rollbackError: No usable rollback executable could be restored.
actions.applyConfirmDescription: GPROXY will download and verify the selected build, replace the executable, and use the configured restart mode.
actions.rollbackConfirmDescription: GPROXY will replace the current executable with the retained backup and use the configured restart mode.

banner.title: GPROXY {{version}} is available
banner.description: A signed update is ready on the selected channel.
